description:
Cast Cultivator Colossus by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Cultivator Colossus enters, it triggers, attempting to put Balduvian Trading Post from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to instead put Balduvian Trading Post into your graveyard.
Afterwards, continue resolving the Cultivator Colossus trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return Balduvian Trading Post from your graveyard to your hand due to its dredge ability. Then, repeat the process, attempting to put Balduvian Trading Post from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to instead put Balduvian Trading Post into your graveyard.
Repeat step 3.
